## About
R S Auto Care is a tire and auto repair shop on Harry Hines Blvd in Dallas. We keep tires in stock and handle full auto repair on all makes and models, so you can take care of both in one stop.
You can browse tire sizes, brands and prices online and we will hold what you pick. If something feels off with your car, describe it in a quote request and we will call you back with a price before any work starts. Walk-ins are welcome too.
Drivers have given us a 4.7 rating from 545 Google reviews. One reviewer who came in stressed with a car that would not start said we were kind, clear, and fixed the problem without pushing anything else.

## Services
- Tires: Tire sizes, brands and prices in stock. Find your size online, pick what you need and we will hold it for you.
- Auto repair: Full auto repair for all makes and models. Tell us the symptoms, warning lights and when it happens, and we will get back to you with an estimate.
- Alignment: One reviewer came in for new tires and an alignment to keep the family safe on the road.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Walk-ins are welcome. You can also book a visit online if you would rather pick a time.

Q: How do I find my tire size?
A: Your size is printed on the sidewall of the tire you have now. If you are not sure about part of it, leave that box on Any when you search.

Q: What are your hours on Saturday?
A: Saturday hours are 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
